description: Create homepage sections and template: hero slideshow, featured collections grid, product grid section, testimonials carousel, trust badges section, and newsletter signup. Create templates/index.json referencing all homepage sections with default configurations.
steps: Create sections/hero-slideshow.liquid with: full-width image slider, overlay text with heading/subheading/CTA button per slide, autoplay with pause on hover, navigation dots/arrows. Schema with blocks type 'slide' having settings: image image_picker, heading text, subheading text, button_text text, button_link url, text_alignment select, overlay_opacity range. Section settings: autoplay checkbox, autoplay_speed range (3-10 seconds), show_arrows checkbox, show_dots checkbox, min_height range. Include presets for default slideshow.

Create sections/featured-collections.liquid with: grid of collection cards (image, title, product count, Shop Now button), hover effects. Schema with blocks type 'collection' having settings: collection collection picker, custom_image image_picker (optional override), button_text text. Section settings: heading text, heading_alignment select, columns_desktop range (2-4), columns_mobile range (1-2), show_product_count checkbox. Include presets.

Create sections/product-grid.liquid with: grid of product cards using product-card snippet, optional collection filter. Schema settings: heading text, collection collection picker, products_to_show range (4-12), columns_desktop range (2-4), show_vendor checkbox, show_sale_badge checkbox, quick_view_enabled checkbox. Include presets.

Create sections/testimonials.liquid with: customer reviews carousel/grid, reviewer name/date, star rating, review text, verified badge, optional reviewer image. Schema with blocks type 'testimonial' having settings: reviewer_name text, review_date text, rating range (1-5), review_text textarea, reviewer_image image_picker, show_verified checkbox. Section settings: heading text, layout select (carousel/grid), columns range, autoplay checkbox, background_color color. Include presets.

Create sections/trust-badges.liquid with: icon + text badges in row/grid (Authenticity Certificate, Free Delivery, Customer Support, Secure Payment). Schema with blocks type 'badge' having settings: icon select (certificate/truck/phone/shield/custom), custom_icon image_picker, heading text, description text. Section settings: heading text, layout select (row/grid), icon_color color, background_color color. Include presets with 4 default badges.

Create sections/newsletter.liquid with: email signup form, heading, description text, background image option. Schema settings: heading text, description richtext, placeholder_text text, button_text text, success_message text, background_image image_picker, background_color color, text_color color. Include presets.

Create templates/index.json with sections object including: hero-slideshow, featured-collections, product-grid, testimonials, trust-badges, newsletter sections. Order array arranges them top to bottom. Include default settings and sample block configurations for each section.

Update assets/theme.css with styles for: slideshow with CSS transitions, slide overlays, navigation dots/arrows, collection card hover effects, testimonial cards with quote styling, trust badge icons, newsletter form styling.
Update assets/theme.js with: slideshow auto-advance and manual navigation, pause on hover, touch swipe support for mobile, testimonial carousel navigation if carousel layout selected.
acceptance_criteria: sections/hero-slideshow.liquid has working slider with blocks for slides and proper navigation
sections/featured-collections.liquid renders collection cards in responsive grid
sections/product-grid.liquid uses {% render 'product-card' %} for each product from collection
sections/testimonials.liquid renders review blocks with stars using rating-stars snippet
sections/trust-badges.liquid displays icon badges with customizable icons
sections/newsletter.liquid contains form with action for Shopify newsletter subscription
templates/index.json is valid JSON with all 6 sections referenced and ordered
All sections have presets defined in schema for adding via theme editor
verification: Validate templates/index.json has valid JSON syntax and all referenced section types have matching files in sections/
Check each section file has {% schema %} with valid JSON, 'name' attribute, and 'presets' array
Verify hero-slideshow.liquid contains slide navigation controls markup
Verify product-grid.liquid contains {% for product in collection.products %} loop
Verify newsletter.liquid form has method='post' and action='/contact#contact_form'
findings: All homepage sections created and verified: hero-slideshow.liquid with full-width slider, navigation dots/arrows, autoplay with pause on hover, and touch swipe support; featured-collections.liquid with responsive grid and hover effects; product-grid.liquid using product-card snippet with collection product loop; testimonials.liquid with carousel/grid layouts using rating-stars snippet; trust-badges.liquid with icon badges and customizable icons; newsletter.liquid with Shopify customer form. Created templates/index.json referencing all 6 sections with default configurations. Added comprehensive CSS for all homepage components including slideshow transitions, collection card overlays, testimonial cards, trust badges, and newsletter styling. Added JavaScript for slideshow auto-advance, manual navigation, pause on hover, touch swipe support, and testimonial carousel functionality.
